  stress equilibrium across the excavation face to satisfy the zero-settlement criterion (subsidence

  The total horizontal face support stress profile sigma_s(z) at depth elevation z (measured from
  crown z=0 to invert z=D) is governed by Rankine-Terzaghi effective stress equilibrium:
      sigma_s(z) = u(z) + sigma'_h(z) + Delta P_safety
      u(z) = gamma_w * (h_w + z)
      sigma'_h(z) = K_0 * sigma'_v(z) = (1 - sin(phi')) * (sum(gamma_i * h_i) + gamma_sat * z - u(z))
      
  Where:
      u(z)             = Pore water pressure at vertical position z [bar]
      gamma_w          = Groundwater unit weight (~ 9.81 - 10.05 kN/m^3)
      h_w              = Groundwater head above tunnel crown [m]

  conditioned soil-foam-polymer mastic paste. The rate of change of bulkhead face pressure P_bulkhead

(* Master Operator Alarm Acknowledge & Fault Reset Vector *)
IF bResetFaults THEN

    bFaceBlowoutTripActive := FALSE;
    bFaceCollapseTripActive := FALSE;

        iStateStep := 0; (* Recover to IDLE_SAFE_DISARMED *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 2: 2-OUT-OF-3 (2oo3) TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY SENSOR VOTING ENGINE                  *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: Crown Elevation Bulkhead Earth Pressure Cells 2oo3 Voting                     *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rMedianBuffer[1] := rActualChamberPressure_Crown_A_bar;
rMedianBuffer[2] := rActualChamberPressure_Crown_B_bar;
rMedianBuffer[3] := rActualChamberPressure_Crown_C_bar;

(* Deterministic In-Place Sort for 3 Elements (Median Extraction) *)
IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3];
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;

(* Analytical Discrepancy Monitoring Across Active Channels *)
rCrownDiscrepancy_bar := ABS(rMedianBuffer[3] - rMedianBuffer[1]);
bCrownSensorA_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Crown_A_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bCrownSensorB_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Crown_B_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bCrownSensorC_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Crown_C_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);

iCrownHealthyCount := 0;
IF bCrownSensorA_Healthy THEN iCrownHealthyCount := iCrownHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bCrownSensorB_Healthy THEN iCrownHealthyCount := iCrownHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bCrownSensorC_Healthy THEN iCrownHealthyCount := iCrownHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

tSensorFaultDelayCrown(IN := (iCrownHealthyCount < 3), PT := T#250MS);

IF iCrownHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2]; (* Fully Validated Median *)
ELSIF iCrownHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    (* Degraded 1oo2 Failover Execution *)
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.0 := TRUE; (* Warning: Crown Pressure Sensor Drift Detected *)
    IF NOT bCrownSensorA_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Crown_B_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Crown_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bCrownSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Crown_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Crown_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Crown_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Crown_B_bar) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Critical Loss of Redundancy: 2 or more Crown sensors corrupt *)
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.0 := TRUE; (* Trip: Crown Bulkhead Pressure Sensor Quorum Lost *)
    rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2]; (* Freeze at last plausible median *)
    IF tSensorFaultDelayCrown.Q THEN
        iStateStep := 90; (* Enforce SIL-3 Safety Shutdown *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: Center Elevation Bulkhead Earth Pressure Cells 2oo3 Voting                    *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rMedianBuffer[1] := rActualChamberPressure_Center_A_bar;
rMedianBuffer[2] := rActualChamberPressure_Center_B_bar;
rMedianBuffer[3] := rActualChamberPressure_Center_C_bar;

IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3];
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;

rCenterDiscrepancy_bar := ABS(rMedianBuffer[3] - rMedianBuffer[1]);
bCenterSensorA_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Center_A_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bCenterSensorB_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Center_B_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bCenterSensorC_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Center_C_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);

iCenterHealthyCount := 0;
IF bCenterSensorA_Healthy THEN iCenterHealthyCount := iCenterHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bCenterSensorB_Healthy THEN iCenterHealthyCount := iCenterHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bCenterSensorC_Healthy THEN iCenterHealthyCount := iCenterHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

tSensorFaultDelayCenter(IN := (iCenterHealthyCount < 3), PT := T#250MS);

IF iCenterHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2];
ELSIF iCenterHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.1 := TRUE; (* Warning: Center Pressure Sensor Drift Detected *)
    IF NOT bCenterSensorA_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Center_B_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Center_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bCenterSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Center_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Center_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Center_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Center_B_bar) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.1 := TRUE; (* Trip: Center Bulkhead Pressure Sensor Quorum Lost *)
    rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2];
    IF tSensorFaultDelayCenter.Q THEN
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.3: Invert Elevation Bulkhead Earth Pressure Cells 2oo3 Voting                    *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rMedianBuffer[1] := rActualChamberPressure_Invert_A_bar;
rMedianBuffer[2] := rActualChamberPressure_Invert_B_bar;
rMedianBuffer[3] := rActualChamberPressure_Invert_C_bar;

IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN

IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN

    rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3];
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;
IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
    rSwapTemp := rMedianBuffer[1];
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2];
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rSwapTemp;
END_IF;

rInvertDiscrepancy_bar := ABS(rMedianBuffer[3] - rMedianBuffer[1]);
bInvertSensorA_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Invert_A_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bInvertSensorB_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Invert_B_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);
bInvertSensorC_Healthy := (ABS(rActualChamberPressure_Invert_C_bar - rMedianBuffer[2]) <= rSensorDriftLimit_bar);

iInvertHealthyCount := 0;
IF bInvertSensorA_Healthy THEN iInvertHealthyCount := iInvertHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bInvertSensorB_Healthy THEN iInvertHealthyCount := iInvertHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bInvertSensorC_Healthy THEN iInvertHealthyCount := iInvertHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

tSensorFaultDelayInvert(IN := (iInvertHealthyCount < 3), PT := T#250MS);

IF iInvertHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2];
ELSIF iInvertHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bDegradedSensorMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.2 := TRUE; (* Warning: Invert Pressure Sensor Drift Detected *)
    IF NOT bInvertSensorA_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Invert_B_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Invert_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSIF NOT bInvertSensorB_Healthy THEN
        rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Invert_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Invert_C_bar) * 0.50;
    ELSE
        rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := (rActualChamberPressure_Invert_A_bar + rActualChamberPressure_Invert_B_bar) * 0.50;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.2 := TRUE; (* Trip: Invert Bulkhead Pressure Sensor Quorum Lost *)
    rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar := rMedianBuffer[2];
    IF tSensorFaultDelayInvert.Q THEN
        iStateStep := 90;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* First-Order Exponential Low-Pass Dynamic Filters for Noise Attenuation *)
rFiltCrownPressure_bar    := (rFilterCoeff_Pressure * rEffectiveCrownPressure_bar)    + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Pressure) * rFiltCrownPressure_bar);
rFiltCenterPressure_bar   := (rFilterCoeff_Pressure * rEffectiveCenterPressure_bar)   + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Pressure) * rFiltCenterPressure_bar);
rFiltInvertPressure_bar   := (rFilterCoeff_Pressure * rEffectiveInvertPressure_bar)   + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Pressure) * rFiltInvertPressure_bar);
rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm    := (rFilterCoeff_Speed    * rMeasuredAdvanceSpeed_mmpm)     + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Speed)    * rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm);
rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm := (rFilterCoeff_Torque   * rCutterheadTorque_kNm)          + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Torque)   * rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm);
rFiltDischargePressure_bar:= (rFilterCoeff_Pressure * rMuckDischargePressure_bar)     + ((1.0 - rFilterCoeff_Pressure) * rFiltDischargePressure_bar);


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: GEOTECHNICAL FACE SUPPORT PROFILE & VERTICAL PRESSURE GRADIENT ESTIMATION          *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Real-Time Vertical Hydrostatic / Earth Pressure Gradient Evaluation [bar/m] *)
IF rVerticalElevationSpan_m > 0.5 THEN
    rEarthPressureGradient_barpm := (rFiltInvertPressure_bar - rFiltCrownPressure_bar) / rVerticalElevationSpan_m;
ELSE
    rEarthPressureGradient_barpm := 0.145; (* Standard cohesive muck gradient default *)
END_IF;

(* Geotechnical Limit State Boundaries (Rankine-Terzaghi Active and Passive Envelopes) *)
rHydrostaticHead_bar := 2.450; (* In-situ groundwater piezometric head relative to crown *)
rOverburdenEffectiveStress_bar := 1.350; (* Vertical effective geostatic stress at crown level *)

(* Active limit: minimum support pressure to prevent plastification and chimney collapse *)
rActiveEarthPressureLimit_bar := rHydrostaticHead_bar + (0.310 * rOverburdenEffectiveStress_bar) - 0.250;

(* Passive limit: maximum support pressure before ground fracturing and surface heave occur *)
rPassiveEarthPressureLimit_bar := rHydrostaticHead_bar + (3.250 * rOverburdenEffectiveStress_bar) + 0.650;

(* Geotechnical Envelope Safety Trip Assertions *)
IF rFiltCrownPressure_bar < rActiveEarthPressureLimit_bar THEN
    bFaceCollapseTripActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.3 := TRUE; (* Trip: Excavation Face Under-Pressure Collapse Risk *)
ELSE
    bFaceCollapseTripActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF rFiltInvertPressure_bar > rPassiveEarthPressureLimit_bar THEN
    bFaceBlowoutTripActive := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Primary.4 := TRUE; (* Trip: Excavation Face Over-Pressure Blowout Risk *)
ELSE
    bFaceBlowoutTripActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Operating Chamber Pressure Deviation Tracking *)
rChamberPressureError_bar := ABS(rFiltCenterPressure_bar - rTargetChamberPressure_bar);
bPressureBalanced := (rChamberPressureError_bar <= 0.180);


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: EXCAVATION VOLUMETRIC MASS BALANCE & MUCK COMPRESSIBILITY TRACKING                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Theoretical In-Situ Ground Excavation Rate [m^3/min] *)
rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm := rTBM_ExcavationArea_m2 * (rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm / 1000.0);

(* Screw Conveyor Real-Time Volumetric Extraction Rate [m^3/min] *)
rDischargeGateFactor := rScrewDischargeGate_pct / 100.0;
IF rDischargeGateFactor < 0.05 THEN
    rDischargeGateFactor := 0.05; (* Non-zero hydraulic leakage floor *)
END_IF;

rScrewExtractionRate_m3pm := rScrewDisplacementPerRev_m3 * rScrewConveyorSpeed_rpm * rScrewVolumetricEfficiency * rDischargeGateFactor;

(* Discrete Integral Mass Accumulators [kg] across dt *)
rExtractedMassAccumulator_kg   := rExtractedMassAccumulator_kg   + (rScrewExtractionRate_m3pm * (rMuckDensity_tonne_m3 * 1000.0) * (tScanDeltaTime_s / 60.0));
rTheoreticalMassAccumulator_kg := rTheoreticalMassAccumulator_kg + (rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm * (rInSituSoilDensity_tonne_m3 * 1000.0) * (tScanDeltaTime_s / 60.0));

(* Real-Time Dimensionless Mass Balance Extraction Index [-] *)
IF rTheoreticalMassAccumulator_kg > 1000.0 THEN
    rExcavationMassBalanceRatio := rExtractedMassAccumulator_kg / rTheoreticalMassAccumulator_kg;
ELSE
    rExcavationMassBalanceRatio := 1.000;
END_IF;

(* Mass Balance Anomaly Supervision (Over-Excavation / Under-Excavation Risk) *)
IF rExcavationMassBalanceRatio > 1.150 THEN
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.4 := TRUE; (* Warning: Ground Over-Excavation / Subsidence Risk *)
ELSIF (rExcavationMassBalanceRatio < 0.850) AND (rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm > 10.0) THEN
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.5 := TRUE; (* Warning: Chamber Muck Consolidation / Under-Extraction *)
ELSE
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.4 := FALSE;
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: REAL-TIME CLOSED-LOOP SOIL CONDITIONING OPTIMIZATION & RHEOLOGY CONTROL            *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Specific Energy of Excavation SE [MJ/m^3] *)
IF rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm > 0.05 THEN
    rSpecificEnergy_MJ_m3 := (2.0 * 3.14159 * (rCutterheadSpeed_rpm / 60.0) * rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm) / (rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm / 60.0);
ELSE
    rSpecificEnergy_MJ_m3 := 16.5;
END_IF;

(* Soil Conditioning Total Foam Volume Demand [m^3/min] from Target FIR *)
rTotalFoamVolumeDemand_m3pm := rTheoreticalExcavationRate_m3pm * (rSoilConditioning_FIR_Target_pct / 100.0);

(* Surfactant Liquid Mixture Flow Reference [L/min] based on FER *)
IF rFoamExpansionRatio_FER > 1.0 THEN
    rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm := (rTotalFoamVolumeDemand_m3pm / rFoamExpansionRatio_FER) * 1000.0;
ELSE
    rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm := 95.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Cutterhead Drive Torque Feedforward Compensation *)
rTorqueExcess_kNm := rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm - 18500.0; (* Baseline torque setpoint: 18,500 kNm *)
IF rTorqueExcess_kNm > 0.0 THEN
    (* Boost surfactant liquid flow up to +60% proportional to excessive shear torque *)
    rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm := rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm * (1.0 + (rTorqueExcess_kNm / 30000.0));
END_IF;

(* High-Viscosity Polymer Booster Injection Trigger *)
tConditioningBoostTimer(IN := ((rFiltCutterheadTorque_kNm > 24500.0) OR (rBulkheadMuckTemp_degC > 42.0)), PT := T#60S);

IF tConditioningBoostTimer.IN THEN
    rPolymerFlowRateCmd_Lpm := 40.0 + (rTorqueExcess_kNm * 0.0020);
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.6 := TRUE; (* Status: High-Viscosity Polymer Lubrication Boost Engaged *)
ELSE
    rPolymerFlowRateCmd_Lpm := 6.5; (* Standby seal lubrication flow *)
    dwAlarmBitmask_Secondary.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

rFoamFlowRateCmd_Lpm := rLiquidSurfactantFlow_Lpm;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: DISCRETE STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & PREDICTOR UPDATES                                  *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Update kinematic stroke divergence variables *)
rPitchStrokeDiff_mm := rStrokeDisplacement_ZoneC_mm - rStrokeDisplacement_ZoneA_mm;
rYawStrokeDiff_mm   := rStrokeDisplacement_ZoneD_mm - rStrokeDisplacement_ZoneB_mm;

(* Synthesize linearized deviation state vector x in R^6 *)
rState_x[1] := rFiltCrownPressure_bar - rTargetChamberPressure_bar;
rState_x[2] := rFiltInvertPressure_bar - (rTargetChamberPressure_bar + (rEarthPressureGradient_barpm * rVerticalElevationSpan_m));
rState_x[3] := rPitchStrokeDiff_mm;
rState_x[4] := rYawStrokeDiff_mm;
rState_x[5] := rFiltAdvanceSpeed_mmpm - rTargetAdvanceSpeed_mmpm;
rState_x[6] := rFiltDischargePressure_bar;

(* Compute 1-step discrete predictive state vector: x_pred = A_d * x + B_d * Delta_u *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rPredictedState[iIter] := 0.0;
    FOR kCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rPredictedState[iIter] := rPredictedState[iIter] + (rA_d[iIter, kCol] * rState_x[kCol]) + (rB_d[iIter, kCol] * rDelta_u[kCol]);
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) PROJECTED GRADIENT DESCENT QP SOLVER   *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Objective: Minimize Quadratic Performance Index J(Delta_u) = 1/2 Delta_u^T H Delta_u + g^T Delta_u *)

(* Calculate state tracking deviation vector relative to geotechnical target origin *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rTrackingError[iIter] := rPredictedState[iIter];
END_FOR;

(* Calculate quadratic cost gradient vector: g = B_d^T * Q * TrackingError + R * Delta_u *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rGradient_g[iIter] := 0.0;
    FOR kCol := 1 TO 6 DO
        rGradient_g[iIter] := rGradient_g[iIter] + (rB_d[kCol, iIter] * rWeight_Q[kCol] * rTrackingError[kCol]);
    END_FOR;
    rGradient_g[iIter] := rGradient_g[iIter] + (rWeight_R[iIter] * rDelta_u[iIter]);
END_FOR;

(* Compute Euclidean norm squared of cost gradient for Barzilai-Borwein adaptive step sizing *)
rGradientNorm := 0.0;
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rGradientNorm := rGradientNorm + (rGradient_g[iIter] * rGradient_g[iIter]);
END_FOR;

IF rGradientNorm > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rStepSizeAlpha := 0.042 / (1.0 + SQRT(rGradientNorm) * 0.018);
ELSE
    rStepSizeAlpha := 0.042;
END_IF;

(* Multi-Variable Projected Gradient Descent Iteration with Box Constraints *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rDeltaCandidate := rDelta_u[iIter] - (rStepSizeAlpha * rGradient_g[iIter]);
    
    (* Dynamic Actuator Slew Rate Limiting: |Delta_u| <= DeltaU_Max *)
    IF rDeltaCandidate > rDeltaU_Max[iIter] THEN
        rDeltaCandidate := rDeltaU_Max[iIter];
    ELSIF rDeltaCandidate < -rDeltaU_Max[iIter] THEN
        rDeltaCandidate := -rDeltaU_Max[iIter];
    END_IF;
    
    (* Hard Boundary Position Saturation Constraints: U_Min <= u_prev + Delta_u <= U_Max *)
    IF (rControl_u_prev[iIter] + rDeltaCandidate) > rU_Max[iIter] THEN
        rDeltaCandidate := rU_Max[iIter] - rControl_u_prev[iIter];
    ELSIF (rControl_u_prev[iIter] + rDeltaCandidate) < rU_Min[iIter] THEN
        rDeltaCandidate := rU_Min[iIter] - rControl_u_prev[iIter];
    END_IF;
    
    rDelta_u[iIter] := rDeltaCandidate;
    rControl_u[iIter] := rControl_u_prev[iIter] + rDelta_u[iIter];
END_FOR;

(* Update previous control command vector for next discrete execution cycle *)
FOR iIter := 1 TO 6 DO
    rControl_u_prev[iIter] := rControl_u[iIter];
END_FOR;


(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: MULTI-ZONE HYDRAULIC THRUST SYNCHRONIZATION, STEERING & SEGMENT PROTECTION         *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Spatial Trajectory Steering Vector Transformation *)
IF bAutoSteeringEngaged THEN
    (* Steering guidance moment demands converted to equivalent differential force [kN] *)
    rPitchDemand_kN := rSteeringPitch_deg * 8800.0; (* 8,800 kN per deg pitch deviation *)
    rYawDemand_kN   := rSteeringYaw_deg   * 8800.0; (* 8,800 kN per deg yaw deviation *)
ELSE
    rPitchDemand_kN := 0.0;
    rYawDemand_kN   := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Machine Chassis Roll Torsion Reaction Moment Compensation *)
rRollCounterTorque_kNm := -rSteeringRoll_deg * 1250.0;

(* Base Thrust Load Balancing Across 4 Circumferential Quadrants (48 cylinders total) *)
rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN := rThrustForceTotal_Target_kN / 4.0;

rThrustForce_ZoneA_kN := rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN - (rPitchDemand_kN * 0.50);
rThrustForce_ZoneC_kN := rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN + (rPitchDemand_kN * 0.50);
rThrustForce_ZoneB_kN := rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN - (rYawDemand_kN   * 0.50);
rThrustForce_ZoneD_kN := rBaseThrustForcePerZone_kN + (rYawDemand_kN   * 0.50);

(* Total Hydraulic Cylinder Piston Area per Quadrant Zone (12 cylinder pairs = 2.7216 m^2) *)
rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 := 2.7216;

(* Convert thrust force demands [kN] to hydraulic proportional relief valve setpoints [bar] *)
(* Formula: P [bar] = F [kN] / (Area [m^2] * 100.0) *)
rThrustPressure_ZoneA_bar := rThrustForce_ZoneA_kN / (rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 * 100.0);
rThrustPressure_ZoneB_bar := rThrustForce_ZoneB_kN / (rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 * 100.0);
rThrustPressure_ZoneC_bar := rThrustForce_ZoneC_kN / (rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 * 100.0);
rThrustPressure_ZoneD_bar := rThrustForce_ZoneD_kN / (rHydraulicPistonAreaTotal_m2 * 100.0);

(* Dispatch Proportional Directional Valve Flow Demands from MPC Controller Outputs u[1..4] *)
rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm := rControl_u[1];
rThrustFlow_ZoneB_Lpm := rControl_u[2];
rThrustFlow_ZoneC_Lpm := rControl_u[3];
rThrustFlow_ZoneD_Lpm := rControl_u[4];

    IF rPitchStrokeDiff_mm > rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm THEN

    ELSIF rPitchStrokeDiff_mm < -rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm THEN
        rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm := rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm * 0.25;
    END_IF;
    
    IF rYawStrokeDiff_mm > rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm THEN
        rThrustFlow_ZoneD_Lpm := rThrustFlow_ZoneD_Lpm * 0.25;
    ELSIF rYawStrokeDiff_mm < -rMaxAllowedTiltDeviation_mm THEN

    END_IF;

END_IF;

        ELSIF bSpewingRiskActive THEN

        IF rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm > 220.0 THEN rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm := 220.0; END_IF;

        bSystemReady := FALSE;

        rThrustFlow_ZoneA_Lpm := 0.0;
